templates.name: app_automation_workflow
templates.title: App 自动化决策流程
templates.description: 从钉钉打卡自动化中提取的通用决策模式。任何'自动操作App X'的任务都应走这个流程：先检查API可用性→无API则检查急速模式→仍不行则模拟点击→都不行则人工介入。避免在错误方向上探索。
templates.author: platform

templates.name: long_form_writer
templates.title: 万字长文生成器
templates.description: 分章节并行生成长文并自动拼接润色。工作流化解决单次LLM输出长度限制：先生成大纲→迭代生成每章→聚合→全文润色。适用于技术文档、分析报告、教程等。
templates.author: platform

templates.name: code_reviewer
templates.title: 代码审查与修复
templates.description: 标准代码审查工作流: 读取源码 → 运行测试 → 定位失败根因 → 最小修改 → 重新验证 → 生成报告。这是最核心的软件开发质量保证流程。
templates.author: platform

templates.name: task_decomposer
templates.title: 任务分解与规划
templates.description: 将复杂任务分解为可执行的子任务并按依赖排序。输入任务描述→LLM拆解→提取子任务→依赖排序→生成格式化计划。
templates.author: platform

templates.name: data_analyzer
templates.title: 数据分析流水线
templates.description: 标准数据分析工作流：加载数据→统计摘要→异常检测→生成报告。适用于CSV/JSON数据的自动化分析场景。

templates.name: document_summarizer
templates.title: 文档摘要生成器
templates.description: 阅读文档并生成多层级摘要：一句话总结→三段要点→完整摘要。适用于合同、论文、长文等场景。
templates.author: platform

templates.name: customer_support_router
templates.title: 智能客服路由
templates.description: 客服消息智能分类与差异化响应。将客户消息分为投诉/咨询/反馈/紧急四类，每类返回差异化响应。

build_plan.goal: Build an editable data analysis BlockFlow with inputs data_description + optional analysis_goal, producing statistical summary, anomaly notes, recommendations, structured statistics (key_findings, record_count, anomalies_found), a reviewer-facing report, and outputs report+statistics. Include mandatory auditable test.
build_plan.strategy: Expand the data_analyzer template (confidence 0.85, deep reuse) then compose additional modules: add analysis_goal input wiring, parameter_extractor for structured stats, template_transform for reviewer-facing report formatting, and a mandatory test with required_node_types. Evidence: reuse_depth=deep sourced from policy_default v0.2.52_adaptive_default_productization.

modules.title: Template Expansion - data_analyzer
modules.purpose: Expand the data_analyzer template which provides the core data analysis pipeline: load data → statistical summary → anomaly detection → report generation.
evidence: Template expanded with 5 nodes: start, llm, parameter_extractor, template_transform, end. All required inputs (data_description, analysis_goal) and outputs (report, statistics) present.

modules.title: Input Wiring - analysis_goal
modules.purpose: Wire the optional analysis_goal input from Start into the analysis LLM prompt so user intent is honored.
evidence: Added template_transform data_analyzer_prompt that renders analysis prompt from start inputs (data_description + analysis_goal). Edge: start→prompt→llm ensures user intent flows into analysis.

modules.title: Structured Statistics Extraction
modules.purpose: Ensure parameter_extractor outputs key_findings, record_count, anomalies_found as structured fields.
evidence: parameter_extractor configured with fields: key_findings (required string), record_count (optional number), anomalies_found (optional number). Test confirmed extraction of 150 records, 4 anomalies, and detailed key findings from LLM output.

modules.title: Reviewer-Facing Report Formatting
modules.purpose: Use template_transform to format a polished reviewer report from statistics.
evidence: template_transform produces reviewer-facing markdown report with sections: summary (key_findings), statistical indicators (record_count, anomalies_found), and full analysis text. End node wires report and statistics outputs.

modules.title: Mandatory Test with Architecture Gates
modules.purpose: Add test with required_node_types proving all visible blocks exist and workflow is auditable.
evidence: Mandatory test test_audit_architecture passes with required_node_types: [start, llm, parameter_extractor, template_transform, end]. All 5 types verified present. Output assertions on report (string) and statistics (object with key_findings) all pass.

risks: Template may not include analysis_goal input
Template blocks need to be connected to new nodes
